matchedTemplate: The approved verifier failed with exit code 1; the host workspace was not changed.
method: Exact SHA-256 match against the fixed TerminalVerificationFailure template in src/harness.ts for exit codes 0..255. No raw verifier output read or exported.
limits: Identifies verifier command failure, not the reason for that command failure.
Does not establish whether repair, verifier, or test environment was incorrect.
No new live request; does not change the failed development sample or GA status.
interpretation: The existing turn already records failure and bounded output. Later null output projections do not prove that feedback was absent at the model boundary.

validation.modelBoundaryRegression: Strict and repair recovery pass bounded verifier output to the next model request. External projection excludes the fixture output.
